**Orbweaver 1.0.3 fixes three things 1.0.2 got wrong on the orbs themselves: dropped orbs that wouldn't stay put, name bubbles and button rings that flickered or stuck open, and chat messages that were typed into a terminal but never sent.** Nothing else has changed since 1.0.2.

## What's fixed

- **A dragged orb now stays where you drop it.** In 1.0.2, an orb you'd never moved before slid back to the stack on the right edge of the screen as soon as you let go, and so did an orb you dragged out of a group or a team lead dragged with its team. How long you held the button made no difference. The second drag of the same orb usually worked, so it could look like the trick was to hold on longer. The first drop now sticks. In arranged mode, and for a group lead dropped next to its own group, the orb still springs back into its slot, as before.
- **Name bubbles no longer flicker across your orbs.** An orb that missed the moment the pointer left it went on acting as if the pointer were still over it, and several such orbs took turns showing their name bubble many times a second, with your mouse nowhere near them. Each orb now checks where the pointer really is, and only one bubble is open at a time.
- **Button rings and usage cards close when you move away.** The same fault left an orb's ring of buttons, or an account orb's usage card, open on orbs you had only brushed past. Sometimes eight or more stayed up until you started a drag. They now close as soon as the pointer is really off them, and only open for the orb the pointer is on.
- **Messages from the chat panel are now sent, not just typed.** Sending to a session running in iTerm2 or Terminal.app on macOS, or in a console window on Windows, put any single-line message longer than about 70 characters into the prompt without submitting it, so you had to switch over and press Return yourself. Codex sessions failed at even shorter lengths, and very long messages could arrive split in two. In kitty and WezTerm, messages were never submitted at any length. All of these now send every message as a single paste and submit it.

## Upgrading

Install over 1.0.2 as usual. Nothing to change.

- **macOS:** as with every upgrade, re-grant Local Network in System Settings → Privacy & Security if your other machines or OpenClaw stop connecting.

## Known limitations

- We fixed the flicker by checking the real pointer position. We still don't know why macOS sometimes fails to tell an orb that the pointer left. The fix doesn't depend on the answer.
- The chat panel fix was measured against one version each of Claude Code and Codex. Terminals reached through tmux were already working and are unchanged.

## Which file do I want

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| macOS, Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `Orbweaver-1.0.3-osx-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Orbweaver-1.0.3-osx-x64.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11, 64-bit | `Orbweaver-1.0.3-win-x64-setup.exe` |

The `OrbweaverSpeech-*.zip` files are the optional neural speech engine. The app downloads the one it needs, so you don't need to.
